mergedParams.userDescription: Text letters dropping down from the top one by one.

output.title: Letters Cascading Down One by One

prompts.prompt: Create a typography preset where text letters drop from the top of the screen one by one, like raindrops falling. Each letter should start above the visible area and fall down to its final position with gravity-like acceleration. The letters should have a subtle bounce effect when they land, mimicking physical impact. Use staggered timing so letters drop sequentially from left to right, creating a cascading effect. The animation should feel organic and playful, with each letter having slightly varied fall duration to avoid mechanical uniformity. Consider adding a subtle shadow that grows as letters approach their landing position to enhance depth perception.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' as containerProps.className. Create individual TextAtom components for each letter using caption data's word-level timing. Apply generic keyframe effects with translateY animation from -150% to 0%, using a custom cubic-bezier easing (0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for the bounce effect. Add opacity fade from 0 to 1 during the first 20% of the fall. Use staggered delays based on letter index (index * 0.08s). Include a scale effect from 0.8 to 1.0 during landing. Add drop-shadow filter that animates from 'drop-shadow(0 0 0 transparent)' to 'drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1))'. Set individual letter containers with 'inline-block' positioning. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' to match total animation duration.

prompts.prompt: Design a cinematic text reveal where letters drop from above like heavy metal typeface elements in a movie title sequence. Each letter should fall with weight and impact, creating a slight screen shake when it lands. The letters should appear to be 3D with perspective, rotating slightly as they fall (like cards flipping). Add motion blur during the fast-falling phase and a dust/debris particle effect on impact. The timing should be dramatic with faster falls and harder impacts for emphasis words. Create a metallic sheen effect that catches light as letters rotate during their descent.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'flex items-end justify-center w-full h-full perspective-1000' containerProps. Use TextAtom for each letter with 'text-6xl font-bold transform-gpu' styling. Implement compound effects: translateY from -200vh to 0, rotateX from -180deg to 0deg, and translateZ for depth. Apply motion blur using filter: 'blur(2px)' during peak velocity (30-70% of animation). Create impact shake with a nested waveform effect triggered at landing time. Use spring easing for realistic physics. Add metallic gradient using background-clip and text-transparent techniques. Generate debris particles as separate ShapeAtom components with outward burst animations. Stagger timing with emphasis on keyword metadata from caption data. Duration per letter: 0.8-1.2s with 0.15s stagger.

prompts.prompt: Build a minimalist typography preset where letters drop gracefully like autumn leaves, with gentle swaying motion as they descend. Each letter should have a pendulum-like horizontal drift while falling, creating an elegant, poetic movement. The letters fade in softly as they begin their descent and settle into place with a smooth deceleration. Use varying fall speeds based on letter 'weight' - lighter letters (i, l, .) fall slower than heavier ones (W, M, @). Add a subtle color shift during the fall, transitioning from a lighter tint to the final color.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' container. Generate TextAtom components with individual letter timing from caption data. Implement dual-axis animation: translateY with ease-out timing, and translateX using sine wave oscillation (Math.sin based on progress * 2π * oscillations). Apply opacity from 0 to 1 over first 30% of fall. Use CSS custom properties for letter-specific fall duration based on character width calculation. Add color animation from 'text-gray-400' to 'text-gray-900' using Tailwind's transition utilities. Set letter containers as 'absolute' with calculated left positions. Use transform-origin: 'top center' for natural pivot. Duration range: 1.5-2.5s based on letter weight, with 0.1s progressive delay.

prompts.prompt: Create a glitch-inspired text drop where letters fall in digital chunks, occasionally stuttering and pixelating during descent. Letters should drop with binary precision but experience random 'data corruption' moments - brief pauses, position jumps, and pixel distortion effects. Add scan lines and chromatic aberration during glitches. The final landing should snap to pixel-perfect positions with a brief digital flicker. Include data stream particles falling alongside letters, creating a matrix-like atmosphere.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative bg-black w-full h-full overflow-hidden' styling. Create TextAtom components with 'font-mono text-green-400' base styling. Implement stepped animation using steps() timing function for main drop, interrupted by random glitch frames. Apply SVG filters for pixelation and chromatic aberration effects during glitch moments (10-15% of animation time). Use transform: 'translate3d()' for GPU acceleration. Add scan line overlay as semi-transparent BaseLayout with animated linear-gradient. Create data particles as small TextAtom or ShapeAtom elements with 'text-xs opacity-30' falling at different speeds. Implement flicker using rapid opacity changes (0.05s intervals) on landing. Use internal effect preset for reusable glitch effect. Total duration: 1s per letter with 0.05s stagger.

prompts.prompt: Develop an elastic cartoon-style letter drop with exaggerated squash and stretch principles from animation. Letters should stretch vertically as they accelerate downward, then squash on impact before bouncing back to normal proportions. Add anticipation with a slight upward movement before the drop begins. Include follow-through with secondary bounces that diminish over time. Each letter should have personality - some tumble, some spin, some wobble. Create comic-style motion lines during the fastest part of the fall.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'flex items-end justify-center w-full h-full' container. Use TextAtom with transform-origin set to 'bottom center' for squash/stretch. Implement multi-phase animation: anticipation (translateY: 10px, 0.2s), acceleration (scaleY: 1.3, scaleX: 0.8), impact (scaleY: 0.7, scaleX: 1.3), and settle (multiple diminishing bounces using exponential decay). Add rotation for tumbling letters using rotateZ with random values. Create motion lines as absolutely positioned BaseLayout divs with 'h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-current to-transparent' styling, animated with scaleX and opacity. Use cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) for elastic easing. Include sub-preset for bounce physics calculation. Duration: 1.5s main drop with 0.3s additional for settling.

prompts.prompt: Design a liquid text drop where letters fall like water droplets, morphing and deforming as they descend. Letters should appear to have surface tension, stretching into teardrop shapes during fall and splashing slightly on impact. Add ripple effects that emanate from each letter's landing point. Include refraction-like distortion on neighboring letters when one lands nearby. The overall effect should feel fluid and organic, with letters seeming to have mass and viscosity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-visible' container. Apply TextAtom with SVG filters for liquid deformation using feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap. Implement path-based animation for teardrop shape using clip-path with polygon values transitioning during fall. Add CSS filter: 'blur()' and 'contrast()' for water-like edges. Create ripple effects as expanding BorderRadius BaseLayout divs with 'absolute rounded-full border-2 border-blue-400/30' animated with scale and opacity. Use transform: 'matrix3d()' for complex deformation during fall. Apply neighbor detection logic to trigger refraction effects on adjacent letters using translateX/Y micro-movements. Include backdrop-filter for glass-like distortion. Timing: ease-in for acceleration, ease-out for landing, with 0.6s base duration and 0.12s stagger.

prompts.prompt: Build a cinematic slow-motion letter drop with dramatic lighting effects. Letters should fall through beams of volumetric light, casting dynamic shadows and catching highlights as they descend. Add depth of field blur for letters at different Z-depths - some in sharp focus, others softly blurred. Include atmospheric particles (dust motes) that react to the falling letters' movement. The timing should be deliberately slow and weighted, emphasizing the grandeur of each letter's journey.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-900 via-gray-800 to-black' for atmospheric depth. Use TextAtom with varying z-index and transform: 'translateZ()' for depth layers. Apply dynamic blur using filter: 'blur()' based on Z-position (0-4px range). Create volumetric light beams as absolutely positioned divs with 'bg-gradient-to-b from-yellow-200/10 to-transparent mix-blend-screen' animated with subtle opacity fluctuation. Implement text-shadow animation for moving highlights: '0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' morphing based on position. Add dust particles as small ShapeAtom elements with 'rounded-full bg-gray-400/20' using physics-based movement affected by letter proximity. Use very slow timing (3-4s per letter) with ease-in-out curves. Include sub-preset for particle physics simulation.

prompts.prompt: Create a typewriter-inspired mechanical drop where letters fall like physical keys being pressed. Each letter should drop straight down with mechanical precision, accompanied by a slight rotation suggesting the arc of a typewriter arm. Add a brief pause at the bottom to simulate the key press moment, followed by a quick spring-back effect. Include subtle vibration on impact and mechanical sounds visualization. Letters should align on an invisible baseline like text on paper.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'flex items-end justify-start w-full h-full font-mono' styling for typewriter aesthetics. Create TextAtom components with 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-900 px-1 rounded shadow-md' to simulate key appearance. Implement two-phase animation: drop phase with translateY and slight rotateX (-5deg), and impact phase with rapid translateY oscillation (2px amplitude, 0.05s duration, 3 cycles). Use steps(1) timing at impact point for mechanical snap. Add box-shadow animation for depth: '0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' during fall to '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' at rest. Create vibration using translateX with random micro-movements (±1px). Include sound wave visualization as expanding circle divs with 'border border-gray-400/50' if audio is present. Timing: 0.4s drop with linear easing, 0.1s impact, 0.06s stagger for rapid typing effect.

prompts.prompt: Develop a gravity-defying reverse drop where letters initially fall slowly, then mysteriously slow down mid-air and reverse direction slightly before settling. Create an otherworldly effect with letters that seem to float in low gravity, gently bobbing as they find their final positions. Add particle trails that follow each letter's path, creating ethereal light streams. Include subtle rotation on multiple axes for a zero-gravity tumble effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-radial from-purple-900/20 to-black' for space atmosphere. Use TextAtom with 'text-white mix-blend-screen' for luminous appearance. Implement complex keyframe sequence: initial drop (0-40%, translateY with ease-in), deceleration (40-60%, decreasing velocity), reverse motion (60-70%, translateY upward 10%), and final settle (70-100%, gentle ease-out to position). Add continuous rotation using rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ with different periods for each axis creating tumbling effect. Create particle trails as multiple small divs with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-gradient-radial from-white to-transparent opacity-60' following letter paths with delay. Use transform-style: 'preserve-3d' for proper 3D rotation. Apply subtle scale pulsing (0.95-1.05) for breathing effect. Duration: 2.5s with 0.2s stagger, using custom cubic-bezier curves for each phase.

prompts.prompt: Design a cascading waterfall text drop where letters flow down in continuous streams at different speeds and layers. Letters should overlap and flow past each other like water over rocks, with some moving faster in the 'current' and others eddying in 'pools'. Add transparency variations to suggest water depth, with letters becoming more opaque as they settle. Include splash effects when fast-moving letters overtake slower ones. Create a sense of continuous flow even after letters reach their positions.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' container. Create multiple layers of TextAtom components with different z-index values and opacity (0.3-1.0 range). Implement variable-speed animations using different duration values based on 'stream' assignment (fast: 0.8s, medium: 1.2s, slow: 1.8s). Apply translateY with different starting points (-100% to -200%) to create continuous flow illusion. Use mix-blend-mode: 'multiply' for overlapping letters to simulate water transparency. Add subtle horizontal drift using translateX with sin wave function for current movement. Create splash effects as rapidly expanding/fading ShapeAtom circles with 'rounded-full border-2 border-white/40' when letters intersect. Include infinite subtle movement post-landing using translateY (±2px) and opacity (0.8-1.0) oscillation. Use internal effect presets for water physics. Implement collision detection for splash triggering. Apply backdrop-filter: 'blur(1px)' on settled letters for depth effect.
